code:
Delta = dV/dS
  Call delta = N(d1)     range 0 to 1
  Put delta  = N(d1) - 1  range -1 to 0

Gamma = dDelta/dS
  same for call & put, always positive (long)
caption: Delta measures direction exposure; Gamma measures how fast Delta itself moves.

code:
Vega  = dV/d(sigma)   positive for long options
Theta = dV/dt         typically negative (time decay)
Rho   = dV/dr         +for calls, -for puts
caption: Each Greek isolates the effect of changing exactly one input, holding the rest fixed.
